COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C24 No.27 of 2020
Hon 'b le Sh ar ad Ku m ar Sh ar m a, J.
Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate, for the
applicant.
Mr. B.M. Pingal, Advocate, for the
respondent.
This is a Transfer Application, which has
been preferred by the defendant to the
proceedings of Suit No.93 of 2020, "Mohit
Kumar Karnwal Vs. Shivani Karnwal",
which was preferred by the respondent/plaintiff
for the dissolution of marriage by invoking the
provisions contained under Sections 13 (i) (ia)
and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, which is
presently pending in the court of Judge, Family
Court, Kotdwar, District Pauri Garhwal.
The contention of the learned counsel for
the applicant is that there are other inter se
matrimonial disputes pending between them
pertaining to the proceedings by way of case
under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act; as
well as proceedings under Section 125 of CrPC,
which are pending consideration before Family
Judge, Dehradun.
In view of the aforesaid facts, that since
two other proceedings are already pending
consideration before the Family Judge,
Dehradun, the prayer has been made that the

proceedings of Suit No.93 of 2020, "Mohit
Kumar Karnwal Vs. Shivani Karnwal", which
is pending before Judge, Family Court,
Kotdwar, District Pauri Garhwal, may be
transferred to the court of competent
jurisdiction at Dehradun.
After having heard the learned Counsels
for the parties, and considering the fact that
since there are multifarious litigations, which
are already going on between the parties, out of
the matrimonial discord amongst them, it would
be rather convenient for the parties, that all lis
are directed to be decided together by one court
i.e. before whom the proceedings under
Sections 9 and 125 of the CrPC, are pending
consideration.
 On the aforesaid limited grounds, this
transfer application would stand allowed. The
Matrimonial Suit No.93 of 2020, "Mohit
Kumar Karnwal Vs. Shivani Karnwal", pending
before the Family Judge, Kotdwar, District
Pauri Garhwal, is directed to be transferred to
Judge, Family Court, Dehradun.
Accordingly, the transfer application
would stand allowed.

( Sh ar ad Ku m ar Sh ar m a, J.)
 18.10.2021
